title: FactorIA rig document (*.rig.json)
description: A skeleton for a model document: a template (humanoid, quadruped, bird, tail, chain, generic) fitted to the model by its parts and landmarks. `rig.bake` writes the skinned .glb (joints and inverse bind matrices; each vertex bound rigidly to its nearest bone). Errors name the file and the JSON pointer; docs/RIGGING.md explains the format and `rig.templates {}` lists the templates.

template.description: Which skeleton: humanoid, quadruped, bird, tail, chain or generic.

options.description: Options of the template (rig.templates lists them); a key the template does not have is an error.

spine.description: Bones between the hips and the neck: spine_1..spine_N. [humanoid: default 3] (quadruped: default 3) (bird: default 2)

neck.description: Bones between the shoulders and the head: neck (one) or neck_1..neck_N. [humanoid: default 1] (quadruped: default 2) (bird: default 3)

tail.description: Tail bones tail_1..tail_N from the hips backwards; 0 = none. [humanoid: default 0] (quadruped: default 4) (bird: default 2)

toes.description: A toe bone on each foot (the ball of the foot bends). false: the foot ends at the ball. [humanoid: default true]

pose.description: The arms' rest pose: "down" (hanging), "out" (held out sideways, T pose) or "auto" (out when the model is wider than 0.75 of its height). [humanoid: default "auto"] (bird: default "auto")

axis.description: The direction the chain grows from its base: +x, -x, +y, -y, +z or -z. The base is at the opposite end of the model. [tail: default "-z"] (chain: default "-y")

parts.description: Bone name -> the model part(s) that decide where it is, when the names of the parts do not say so. A name that is not a part of the model is an error.

landmarks.description: Explicit joint positions [x, y, z] in the model's space (after its gameReady origin), by bone name; "<bone>.tail" is the end of a bone with no children. Wins over parts and proportions.

symmetryX.description: The x of the symmetry plane (left = +X of it). Default: the centre of the model's bounds.

strict.description: A landmark that could only be estimated from the template's proportions is an error. Default false.

binding.description: How the .glb binds vertices: "rigid", each vertex wholly to its nearest bone among the bones of its part. Default "rigid".

path.description: Project-relative file under assets/ ending in .glb. Left out: next to the document, with .glb instead of .rig.json.

bones.description: generic template only: the bones, parents before children.

name.description: The bone's name: lowercase letters, digits and underscores.

parent.description: The bone it hangs from, listed earlier. Left out: root.

role.description: What the bone is for retargeting (arm_upper, hand...). Left out: the name.

part.description: The model part this bone moves; its joint is placed in that part's bounds.

anchor.description: Where in the part's bounds the joint is, -1..1 around the centre. Default [0, 0, 0].

tailAnchor.description: The same for the end of a bone with no children. Left out: the opposite side of the part from `anchor`.
